name: Mo's Academy
desc:
Mo's Academy is dedicated to providing its students with an exceptional opportunity to learn and grow. Attend your classes, work hard, and follow the school rules. We can't wait to have you with us and we look forward to you meeting the school's beloved mascot, Mo! 
Let's go Rabbits!


Created by Samson
This game is unrelated to the Camping series
It is possible that this game will be the first of a new collection
